# DocInspector

> DocInspector is a free, privacy-first **batch document processing toolkit**. Upload up to 100 files at once, select multiple operations, and they all run in sequence on every file. Online processing runs on a secure VPS server in Germany (EU) — files are deleted immediately after download. Also available as a **desktop application for Windows** (fully offline, no uploads).

## What Makes DocInspector Unique

Most PDF tools do **one thing to one file**. DocInspector does **multiple things to many files at once**.

- Upload 1 to 100 files simultaneously (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, images, PPTX)
- Select multiple operations — they run **in sequence** on every file in one batch
- Example: 50 PDFs → Repair broken structure → Remove metadata → Encrypt with password → Add watermark → Download as ZIP
- Online version: files processed on a **VPS server in Germany (EU)**, deleted immediately after download — never stored or shared
- No account required. No cloud storage. No data retention. GDPR-safe by design.
- Also available as a **desktop application** (offline, same features)

## Core Use Cases

### Batch PDF Security Pipeline
Select Sanitize + Encrypt + Flatten on 50 PDFs at once. Result: all files stripped of metadata, password-protected, and converted to image-only PDFs (no selectable text, no hidden data).

### Legal & Compliance Document Preparation
Redact sensitive keywords across an entire folder of contracts, then apply watermark "CONFIDENTIAL" and encrypt — all in one run, on all files simultaneously.

### Accountant / Auditor Bundle Reporting
Upload a folder of 100+ PDF/DOCX/XLSX files, run PDF Bundle Summary or Advanced Bundle Report — get an Excel + PDF + CSV report with document titles, page counts, file sizes, SHA-256 signatures, protection status, and totals. Used for creating "borderou" (document registry) in Romanian/Moldovan accounting practice.

### Document Repair + OCR
Upload corrupted or scanned PDFs, run Rebuild & Repair with Smart OCR — fixes broken PDF structures and makes scanned text selectable and searchable.

### Metadata Privacy Cleanup
Before sending documents externally, run Sanitize on all files — removes author names, creation dates, software fingerprints, GPS data, and all hidden metadata from PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, images, and PPTX files.

## Available Operations (can be combined and run together)

| Operation | Description | Formats |
|---|---|---|
| Sanitize Metadata | Remove all hidden metadata (author, date, GPS, software) | PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, Images, PPTX |
| Add Watermark | Stamp diagonal text watermark on every page (customizable text, font, opacity, size) | PDF |
| Encrypt PDF | Password-protect with AES-256, restrict printing/copying/editing | PDF |
| Find & Redact | Permanently black out specific keywords or phrases | PDF |
| Flatten to Image PDF | Convert every page to raster image — removes text layer, scripts, form fields | PDF |
| Rebuild & Repair PDF | Fix corrupted/broken PDF structures, Smart OCR for scanned pages | PDF |
| Remove Signatures | Strip digital signatures, certified locks, editing restrictions | PDF |
| PDF Bundle Summary | Generate Excel+PDF+CSV report: document titles, page counts, totals | PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT |
| Advanced Bundle Report | Detailed report: doc number, title, format, size, SHA-256, protection status, page count, last modified | PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT |

## How the Pipeline Works

1. **Upload**: Drag & drop up to 100 files or entire folders. Supports PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, PNG, JPG, PPTX.
2. **Select operations**: Click one or more tool cards. Each selected operation shows its settings panel.
3. **Configure**: Set watermark text, encryption password, redaction keywords, OCR mode, etc.
4. **Process**: Click Run — all selected operations execute in sequence on all uploaded files simultaneously.
5. **Download**: Processed files packaged as a ZIP archive.

## Target Users

- Legal professionals preparing batches of contracts for sharing (redact + encrypt + watermark)
- Accountants and auditors creating document bundle reports (borderou/reestr)
- IT and compliance teams sanitizing documents before archival or external sharing
- HR departments processing employee files in bulk
- Anyone needing to apply multiple PDF operations to many files at once without uploading to cloud services

## Privacy & Security

- **Online version**: files are sent over HTTPS to a VPS server in Germany (EU), processed, then deleted immediately after you download — never stored, never shared
- **Desktop version**: fully offline — no internet required, files never leave your computer
- No accounts required for online tools
- No cloud storage, no data retention
- GDPR-compliant: EU server, immediate deletion, no logs of file content

## Desktop Application

DocInspector Desktop is available for **Windows only**. Same features as the online version, fully offline — no internet connection required. Download at: https://doc-inspector.com/en/download.html

## Languages

Available in English, Romanian (ro), and Russian (ru).
